comparison.objective: Candidate installs, uses, and removes a lifting pin; record releases a cordless-drill battery and places it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Both include button actuation and axial removal, but candidate also requires precision insertion, mechanical ball-lock engagement, shackle lifting, load transfer, and unloaded extraction; record requires simultaneous dual-button squeezing and rail sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires verified retention, a suspended lift, three-pad seating, then safe pin withdrawal; record requires remembered dual-button actuation, pack separation, tray placement, release, stillness, and drill-position limits.
comparison.reason: Shared release-and-withdraw primitives do not establish overlap because the record never tests installing or load-proving a temporary lifting attachment.
